name: oracle-fusion-cloud-erp
label: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
description: Enterprise resource planning suite covering financials, procurement, project accounting, supply chain, and more.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The host of your Oracle Fusion Cloud instance, such as your-instance.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com.

create_invoice.label: Create Invoice
create_invoice.description: Creates a new payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceNumber.label: Invoice Number
invoiceNumber.description: Unique invoice number from the supplier.

businessUnit.label: Business Unit
businessUnit.description: The business unit name for the invoice.

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.description: The supplier name on the invoice.

supplierSite.label: Supplier Site
supplierSite.description: The supplier site from where goods/services are rendered.

termsDate.label: Terms Date
termsDate.description: Date used with payment terms to calculate due dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentTerms.label: Payment Terms
paymentTerms.description: Payment terms used to calculate due dates.

invoiceGroup.label: Invoice Group
invoiceGroup.description: Group name for reporting and payment purposes.

requester.label: Requester
requester.description: Name of the person who requested the goods or services.

get_invoice.label: Get Invoice
get_invoice.description: Retrieves details of a specific payables invoice by ID.

invoiceId.label: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice (InvoiceId or invoicesUniqID).

find_invoices.label: Find Invoices
find_invoices.description: Search for payables invoices with optional filters.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

update_invoice.label: Update Invoice
update_invoice.description: Updates an existing payables invoice. Note: Only certain attributes can be updated and cascade defaulting does not apply.

invoiceId.label: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to update.

update_invoice.beforeRequest:
if (!request.body || Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field must be provided to update the invoice.');
return request;

delete_invoice.label: Delete Invoice
delete_invoice.description: Deletes a payables invoice from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.label: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to delete.

delete_invoice.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Invoice ' + inputs.invoiceId + ' deleted successfully.' };

validate_invoice.label: Validate Invoice
validate_invoice.description: Validates a payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.label: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to validate.

cancel_invoice.label: Cancel Invoice
cancel_invoice.description: Cancels a payables invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

invoiceId.label: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to cancel.

create_receivables_invoice.label: Create Receivables Invoice
create_receivables_invoice.description: Creates a new receivables (AR) invoice in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

businessUnit.label: Business Unit
businessUnit.description: The business unit under which the invoice is created.

transactionType.label: Transaction Type
transactionType.description: The transaction type assigned to the invoice.

transactionSource.label: Transaction Source
transactionSource.description: The transaction source assigned to the invoice.

transactionNumber.label: Transaction Number
transactionNumber.description: The transaction number assigned to the invoice. If not provided, it will be auto-generated.

transactionDate.label: Transaction Date
transactionDate.description: The date when the invoice was created (YYYY-MM-DD).

accountingDate.label: Accounting Date
accountingDate.description: The accounting date assigned to the invoice (YYYY-MM-DD).

billToCustomerNumber.label: Bill-to Customer Account Number
billToCustomerNumber.description: The account number of the bill-to customer.

billToCustomerName.label: Bill-to Customer Name
billToCustomerName.description: The name of the bill-to customer.

billToSite.label: Bill-to Site
billToSite.description: The number that identifies the bill-to customer site.

invoiceCurrencyCode.label: Invoice Currency
invoiceCurrencyCode.description: The currency code of the invoice (e.g., USD, EUR).

paymentTerms.label: Payment Terms
paymentTerms.description: The payment terms assigned to the invoice.

dueDate.label: Due Date
dueDate.description: The date when the invoice is due (YYYY-MM-DD).

purchaseOrder.label: PO Number
purchaseOrder.description: The purchase order number on the invoice.

invoiceStatus.label: Invoice Status
invoiceStatus.description: The completion status of the invoice. Must be Complete when creating.

shipToCustomerNumber.label: Ship-to Customer
shipToCustomerNumber.description: The registry identifier of the ship-to customer.

shipToCustomerName.label: Ship-to Customer Name
shipToCustomerName.description: The name of the customer who receives the goods or services.

legalEntityIdentifier.label: Legal Entity Identifier
legalEntityIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the legal entity.

crossReference.label: Reference
crossReference.description: The reference field default value from the transaction source.

get_receivables_invoice.label: Get Receivables Invoice
get_receivables_invoice.description: Retrieves details of a specific receivables invoice by ID.

customerTransactionId.label: Customer Transaction ID
customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice.

find_receivables_invoices.label: Find Receivables Invoices
find_receivables_invoices.description: Search for receivables invoices with optional filters.

billToCustomerNumber.label: Bill-to Customer Account Number
billToCustomerNumber.description: Filter by bill-to customer account number.

billingDateFrom.label: Billing Date From
billingDateFrom.description: Filter invoices with billing date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

billingDateTo.label: Billing Date To
billingDateTo.description: Filter invoices with billing date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

update_receivables_invoice.label: Update Receivables Invoice
update_receivables_invoice.description: Updates an existing receivables invoice. Note: Only InvoiceStatus, PaymentTerms, and TransactionDate can be updated.

customerTransactionId.label: Customer Transaction ID
customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice to update.

invoiceStatus.label: Invoice Status
invoiceStatus.description: The completion status of the invoice.

paymentTerms.label: Payment Terms
paymentTerms.description: The payment terms assigned to the invoice.

transactionDate.label: Transaction Date
transactionDate.description: The date when the invoice was created (YYYY-MM-DD).

update_receivables_invoice.beforeRequest:
if (!request.body || Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field (InvoiceStatus, PaymentTerms, or TransactionDate) must be provided to update.');
return request;

delete_receivables_invoice.label: Delete Receivables Invoice
delete_receivables_invoice.description: Deletes a receivables invoice from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

customerTransactionId.label: Customer Transaction ID
customerTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the receivables invoice to delete.

delete_receivables_invoice.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Receivables invoice ' + inputs.customerTransactionId + ' deleted successfully.' };

create_payment.label: Create Payment
create_payment.description: Creates a new manual payment in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

businessUnit.label: Business Unit
businessUnit.description: The business unit name for the payment.

paymentNumber.label: Payment Number
paymentNumber.description: The check number printed on physical check.

paymentDate.label: Payment Date
paymentDate.description: The date when the payment is made (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentCurrency.label: Payment Currency
paymentCurrency.description: The currency in which payment is made (e.g., USD).

paymentMethodCode.label: Payment Method Code
paymentMethodCode.description: The payment method code (e.g., CHECK, EFT).

payee.label: Payee
payee.description: The party name to whom payment is made.

payeeSite.label: Payee Site
payeeSite.description: The supplier site name to whom payment is made.

paymentDocument.label: Payment Document
paymentDocument.description: The name of the payment document.

paymentDescription.label: Payment Description
paymentDescription.description: The user description for the payment.

disbursementBankAccountName.label: Disbursement Bank Account
disbursementBankAccountName.description: The name of the internal bank account from where the payment is made.

remitToAccountNumber.label: Remit-to Account Number
remitToAccountNumber.description: The supplier's bank account number for electronic payment.

conversionRateType.label: Conversion Rate Type
conversionRateType.description: The type of conversion rate used for foreign currency payments.

conversionRate.label: Conversion Rate
conversionRate.description: The conversion rate for foreign currency payments.

addressLine1.label: Address Line 1
addressLine1.description: The first address line of party to whom the payment is made.

city.label: City
city.description: The city name of the party to whom the payment is made.

state.label: State
state.description: The state name of the party to whom the payment is made.

country.label: Country
country.description: The country name of the party to whom the payment is made.

zip.label: Postal Code
zip.description: The postal code of the party to whom the payment is made.

get_payment.label: Get Payment
get_payment.description: Retrieves details of a specific payment by Check ID.

checkId.label: Check ID
checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment.

find_payments.label: Find Payments
find_payments.description: Search for payments with optional filters.

paymentDateFrom.label: Payment Date From
paymentDateFrom.description: Filter payments on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

paymentDateTo.label: Payment Date To
paymentDateTo.description: Filter payments on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

update_payment.label: Update Payment
update_payment.description: Updates descriptive and global flexfields for a payment.

checkId.label: Check ID
checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to update.

voidDate.label: Void Date
voidDate.description: The date when the payment is voided (YYYY-MM-DD).

voidAccountingDate.label: Void Accounting Date
voidAccountingDate.description: The date when the voided payment is accounted (YYYY-MM-DD).

update_payment.beforeRequest:
if (!request.body || Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field must be provided to update the payment.');
return request;

stop_payment.label: Stop Payment
stop_payment.description: Initiates a stop payment request for a payment.

checkId.label: Check ID
checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to stop.

stopReason.label: Stop Reason
stopReason.description: The reason for stopping the payment.

stopReference.label: Stop Reference
stopReference.description: A reference for the stop payment request.

void_payment.label: Void Payment
void_payment.description: Voids a payment by setting the void date.

checkId.label: Check ID
checkId.description: The unique identifier of the payment to void.

voidDate.label: Void Date
voidDate.description: The date when the payment is voided (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

voidAccountingDate.label: Void Accounting Date
voidAccountingDate.description: The date when the voided payment is accounted (YYYY-MM-DD).

void_payment.beforeRequest:
request.body = Object.assign({ VoidDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] }, request.body);
return request;

get_journal_batch.label: Get Journal Batch
get_journal_batch.description: Retrieves details of a specific journal batch by ID.

jeBatchId.label: Journal Batch ID
jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch.

expand.label: Expand Child Resources
expand.description: Select child resources to include in the response, as a list such as ["journalHeaders", "journalErrors"]: journalHeaders, journalErrors, journalActionLogs, batchAttachment, journalBatchDFF.

find_journal_batches.label: Find Journal Batches
find_journal_batches.description: Search for journal batches with optional filters.

createdBy.label: Created By
createdBy.description: Filter by the user who created the batch.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 25, max: 500).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

update_journal_batch.label: Update Journal Batch
update_journal_batch.description: Updates batch completion status and reversal attributes. Note: Only status and reversal attributes can be updated.

jeBatchId.label: Journal Batch ID
jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch to update.

reversalFlag.label: Reverse Journals
reversalFlag.description: Indicates whether to reverse all journals in the batch.

reversalDate.label: Reversal Date
reversalDate.description: The reversal date for the journals in the batch (YYYY-MM-DD).

reversalPeriod.label: Reversal Period
reversalPeriod.description: The reversal period for the journals in the batch.

reversalMethodMeaning.label: Reversal Method
reversalMethodMeaning.description: The reversal method for the journals in the batch.

update_journal_batch.beforeRequest:
if (!request.body || Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field (Status or reversal attributes) must be provided to update.');
return request;

delete_journal_batch.label: Delete Journal Batch
delete_journal_batch.description: Deletes a journal batch from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

jeBatchId.label: Journal Batch ID
jeBatchId.description: The unique identifier of the journal batch to delete.

delete_journal_batch.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Journal batch ' + inputs.jeBatchId + ' deleted successfully.' };
